summary: A Vietnamese-language Flask stock-screening dashboard using mock OHLCV data for about 15 Vietnamese stocks across 100 sessions. It compares Trend Following and Mean Reversion strategies, presents capital-sizing recommendations, and includes lessons inspired by Edward Thorp.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Flask Stock Screening Backend.
questions.answer: Serve a Vietnamese-language stock dashboard and provide mock OHLCV data for about 15 Vietnam-listed stocks across 100 sessions. Implement Trend Following and Mean Reversion screening, compare strategy signals, rank at most five recommendations, and expose capital sizing that clearly distinguishes a fixed 20% allocation from Quarter-Kelly sizing. Include Edward Thorp lessons. Keep the data and results clearly labeled as demo/mock, not live market data or investment advice.
